entry.title: Updated: dsh-file-drop
entry.summary: Drag & drop or click to attach any non-image file (PDF/Word/Excel/ZIP/text) into the composer: in the desktop shell it resolves the real Finder path instantly; otherwise it uploads to the workspace and inserts the path.
